Contains 60
Alisa Bosconovitch Alisa is an android created by Doctor Bosconovitch in the Bosconovitch Laboratory, a Mishima Zaibatsu facility that served as a hub for the organization’s military equipment development. Ancient Ogre Ogre is the Tekken series' first main villain who is not a member of the Mishima family, though its powers are equal to those of the Mishima and Kazama Clans. Angel Angel is a mysterious being about whom little is known, but fought Devil in order to try and save Kazuya Mishima's soul.
